column1: # NA 4.VEL 2039, "Verklaringe der Letteren" legend block: region native 780,980,2100,2800 (GAPS5) plus the right-hand strip
# native 2800,980,1300,2800 (GAPS6, 2 Oct 2026, images/2039_legend_right_native.jpg; 80 px overlap) of the 11267x8656 sheet.
# GAPS5-na-suriname-map-1781, 2 Oct 2026: two blind Sonnet passes on tools/iiif_lines.py band crops, merged by
# sequence alignment after code normalisation; conf H = both passes read the same sign at an aligned position, M = the
# passes differ (pass A kept, the other reading in the note) or only one pass read the position. Label letters are plain
# on the sheet and are the line id; "head" is the line under the title at the top of the region (L01). Sign codes: bare
# ASCII = a Latin-letter- or digit-shaped glyph as both readers saw it; bracketed = a shape code (glyphs.md plus this
# job's: [thorn] looped p/thorn initial, [pi] pi-like, [f-loop] long-f loop, [u-dots] y/u with diaeresis, [d-loop]
# looped d, [w-tilde] w with tilde, [hand-box] three-bar box, [dots] x-with-dot, [psi]). "3" is kept distinct from
# GAPS6-na-suriname-map-1781, 2 Oct 2026: the strip adds the ends of head, c, g, r and the whole of d, h, o, p (two blind
# Sonnet passes on 15 band crops, 97/119 aligned positions, one own reconciliation on a montage of bands L01/L04/L05);
# new codes [4-bowl] (a 4 with a closed bowl), [dash] (a long dash on the line). GAPS5's 13 "o" signs are now p pos 19-31
# (o's clause is complete on its own line before the p. label); the strip's bands L06-L15 carry no text (map drawing).
